name: zelab
description: ZELab — Distribution ERP (Vercel deploy root: builds the static SPA and runs the Express API as a serverless function).

scripts.build: prisma migrate deploy --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && rm -rf node_modules/.prisma node_modules/.prisma-client server/node_modules/.prisma && prisma generate --schema=server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
